mismatches.say: A peril is the cause of loss: fire, windstorm, collision.
mismatches.heard: Apparel is the cause of loss. Fire, windstorm collision.

mismatches.say: The fire is the peril, the cause. The burned value you claim is the loss.
mismatches.heard: The fire is the peril, the cause. The burned value claim is the loss.

mismatches.say: Five ways to handle risk. Handle risk like a STARR: Share it, Transfer it, Avoid it, Reduce it, or Retain it.
mismatches.heard: Five ways to handle risk. Handle risk like a star. Share it, transfer it, avoid it, reduce it, or retain it.

mismatches.say: Not catastrophic. Watch out: an EXCEPT question may claim the loss should be catastrophic. It shouldn't.
mismatches.heard: Not catastrophic. Watch out. An accept question may claim the loss should be catastrophic. It should not.

mismatches.say: Adverse selection is the threat: people who see a high chance of loss buy insurance far more often. Underwriting exists largely to counter it.
mismatches.heard: Adverse selection is the threat. People who see a high chance of loss by insurance far more often. Underwriting exists largely to counter it.

mismatches.say: Insurers buy insurance too. A reinsurer, for a premium, covers part or all of the liability of the primary insurer, called the ceding company.
mismatches.heard: Insurers buy insurance too. A re-insurer for a premium covers part or all of the liability of the primary insurer, called the seating company.

mismatches.say: Quota share, a pro rata form, shares premium and losses at the same percentage. Excess of loss pays only above the ceding company's retention, up to a limit.
mismatches.heard: QuotaShare, a pro-rata form, shares premium and losses at the same percentage. Excess of loss pays only above the seeding company's retention, up to a limit.

mismatches.say: Try this. A reinsurer takes an agreed percentage of the premium on every policy in a class and pays that percentage of every loss. Which type is it? Pick an answer.
mismatches.heard: Try this. A re-insurer takes an agreed percentage of the premium on every policy in a class and pays that percentage of every loss. Which type is it? Pick an answer.

mismatches.say: To recap: a hazard is the condition, a peril the cause. Pure risk is generally insurable; speculative can bring a gain.
mismatches.heard: To recap, a hazard is the condition, apparel the cause. Pure risk is generally insurable. Speculative can bring a gain.

mismatches.say: Handle risk like a STARR. Ideally insurable risks are a CLEAN Deal. Stockholders own a stock company; policyholders own a mutual.
mismatches.heard: Handle risk like a star. Ideally insurable risks are a clean deal. Stockholders own a stock company. Policyholders own a mutual.
